name: Corona Crossings
description: Corona Crossings is a vibrant community shopping center serving the Corona area with a diverse mix of retail, dining, and service tenants. Conveniently located off Cabot Drive, this open-air center provides easy access and ample parking for shoppers seeking everyday conveniences and specialty stores. The center has established itself as a neighborhood destination for both routine shopping needs and casual dining experiences.
summary: A convenient community shopping center in Corona offering diverse retail, dining, and services in an accessible open-air format.
